name: TDuck
description: Build forms and manage submission data on TDuck with natural language.
description_zh: 通过自然语言在 TDuck（填鸭表单）上创建、复制、编辑表单与题目结构，发布表单开启数据收集，分页查询与批量管理填报数据。
description_en: Create, copy, and edit forms and question structures on TDuck, publish forms for data collection, and manage submission entries using natural language.
examples_zh: 帮我建一个 2026 秋季校招简历登记表并直接发布
查询最近收集到的 10 条表单填报数据
在当前表单末尾追加一道微信号题目
examples_en: Help me create a 2026 campus recruitment registration form and publish it.
Query the latest 10 submission entries from this form.
Add a WeChat ID question to the end of the current form.
